title: Write and solve systems of linear equations for real-world problems

sections.skill: Write and solve systems of linear equations for real-world problems

questions.skill: Write and solve systems of linear equations for real-world problems
questions.prompt: A school sells 200 tickets. Adult tickets cost $6 and student tickets cost $4. The sales total $940. Write a system and solve it to find how many of each ticket were sold.
questions.prompt_markup:
A school sells 200 tickets. Adult tickets cost $6 and student tickets cost $4. The sales total $940.
Write a system and solve it to find how many of each ticket were sold.
questions.correct_answer: The system a + s = 200 and 6a + 4s = 940, and the answer 70 adult and 130 student tickets
questions.grading_note: Both parts are required: a valid equation (or system) and the correct solution. Any valid model is accepted, but the solution must also be correct.

questions.skill: Write and solve systems of linear equations for real-world problems

questions.prompt_markup:
Plan A costs $15 plus $0.05 per minute. Plan B costs $0.10 per minute.
Write a system and solve it to find when the plans cost the same.
questions.correct_answer: The system c = 15 + 0.05m and c = 0.10m, and the answer 300 minutes (both cost $30)
questions.grading_note: Both parts are required: a valid equation (or system) and the correct solution. Any valid model is accepted, but the solution must also be correct.

sections.skill: Create cost, revenue, and profit equations in two variables and graph them

questions.skill: Create cost, revenue, and profit equations in two variables and graph them
questions.standard_level: High school (Common Core high-school standard; this bank places it at Grade 9 as a first forward step. This is an instructional choice, not an official grade assignment.)
questions.response: draw on the figure and write an answer
questions.prompt: A company's cost is C = 2,000 + 15x dollars and its revenue is R = 40x dollars for x items. Graph both equations for 0 ≤ x ≤ 120 (the vertical axis is in hundreds of dollars), label each line, and mark the break-even point.
questions.prompt_markup:
A company's cost is C = 2,000 + 15x dollars and its revenue is R = 40x dollars for x items.
Graph both equations for 0 ≤ x ≤ 120 (the vertical axis is in hundreds of dollars), label each line, and mark the break-even point.
questions.correct_answer: (80, 3,200): 80 items, where cost and revenue are both $3,200
questions.drawing_answer: On the grid (in hundreds of dollars): the cost line from (0, 20) to (120, 38) and the revenue line from (0, 0) to (120, 48), labeled, meeting at (80, 32)
questions.grading_note: Grade both: the two labeled lines, and the break-even point.

figure.description: Coordinate grid with x from 0 to 120 and y from 0 to 50. x-axis label "Items", y-axis label "Hundreds of dollars". Nothing is plotted; the student draws on it.
